concepts.name: Angles
concepts.definition: Central learning focus developed by the chapter 'Angles'.
concepts.evidence: Learners can be asked to rotate themselves around and stop as the teacher announces “statue”.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Using chapter information to support an explanation or answer.
concepts.evidence: The learners can notice how much they have turned with respect to their original position.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Using the chapter idea in a new but related situation.
concepts.evidence: Can you recognise the child in the picture who has made a full turn?
